policies.name: 8 · Fixed revisits
policies.description: Inspect every region every four days; same views and inference model as the adaptive policies.

policies.name: 9 · Confidence only
policies.description: An intentionally incomplete control: defer when the last estimate is confident and healthy, without aging the belief or enforcing a maximum audit gap.

policies.name: 10 · Predictive revisits
policies.description: Issue finite deferrals from predicted change and damage risk. Physical-process uncertainty grows while the drone is absent.

policies.name: 11 · Revocable + information NBV
policies.description: A region's deferral also depends on calibration. Announced sensor changes revoke evidence; choose from the same view actions as the final stage using current marginal information gain.

policies.name: 12 · Renewal-value NBV
policies.added: Choose views by future scan burden
policies.description: Choose among regional, complementary and shared-reference views by expected deferral-days recovered per acquisition cost. One shared check can renew multiple regions without pretending they were physically rescanned.

scenarios.name: Mixed stability
scenarios.description: Two well-estimated stable regions, one uncertain seam, and one growing crack.

scenarios.name: Shared evidence is revoked
scenarios.description: Day 18: a publicly reported sensor-calibration event invalidates shared evidence. Its bias magnitude is unknown to the planner.
